You may be more likely to internalize stress and anxiety, which can lead to a more introspective and self-reliant approach to decision-making. 7. **Self-sacrifice**: As a protector and provider, you may be more willing to make sacrifices for the benefit of your family. This can lead to a decision-making style that prioritizes the needs of others over your own desires or interests.
